entries.title: Results filters
entries.summary: Use the tier and geography filters to narrow the current survey's published results.
entries.body: Tier 1 shows all published responses for the survey. Tier 2 limits the view to responses tied to a verified Wyoming address. The geography dropdown then lets you review statewide, State House, or State Senate results when data is available for that grouping.

entries.title: Your verified districts
entries.summary: These shortcuts jump to the same district filters available in the geography dropdown.
entries.body: If your account has a verified Wyoming address, this section shows your current House and Senate districts. Choosing one of these links applies the same geography filter as selecting that district from the dropdown.

entries.title: District legislators
entries.summary: Representative cards appear when the selected geography maps to a Wyoming legislative district.
entries.body: When you choose a State House or State Senate district, the page looks up the legislators tied to that district and shows available contact and profile details. Statewide and state-level views do not show a district legislator card.

entries.title: Publishing threshold
entries.summary: Some survey and geography combinations do not yet have enough responses to publish detailed results.
entries.body: Results are shown only when at least 10 responses exist for the selected survey, tier, and geography combination. If a district has fewer responses than that threshold, the page shows the current count and waits to publish detailed charts until the minimum is reached.

entries.title: Responses
entries.summary: Use these actions to show support, disagreement, request stronger support, reply to a statement, or report a problem.
entries.body: Reactions help show how the community is responding to a comment.

entries.title: Browse by tag
entries.summary: Select a tag to focus on similar statements.
entries.body: Matching comments are ordered by date, with the newest published statements first.

entries.title: Statement
entries.summary: Use this space to share your position, add an idea, or suggest an improvement related to the topic.
entries.body: Keep your comment clear, concise, and civil. Statements are limited to 500 characters. If a source would help others verify your point, you can add a public link below.

entries.title: Tags
entries.summary: Use tags to group related statements.
entries.body: Use tags to group related statements. Start each tag with # and separate multiple tags with commas. If you leave tags blank, your statement will be tagged #opinion by default. For example: #AI, #healthcare, #education

entries.title: Sources
entries.summary: Add up to 3 public links that support your statement.
entries.body: Use direct source links, public records, official documents, or other clearly described evidence when possible.
